description: This file defines the SimpleClassMapConstructor class, which implements ClassMapConstructor. It provides methods for retrieving tag names by class and finding classes by tag name within an Android project context, utilizing IntelliJ IDEA APIs.

classes.name: SimpleClassMapConstructor
classes.description: Implements ClassMapConstructor, provides methods for class name mapping and class lookup within Android projects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SimpleClassMapConstructor.

methods.name: getTagNamesByClass
methods.description: Returns tag names for a given PsiClass, considering Android library classes.

methods.name: isAndroidLibraryClass
methods.description: Checks if a class is an Android library class based on its qualified name.

methods.name: findClassByTagName
methods.description: Finds a PsiClass by tag name within an AndroidFacet, considering inheritance and class scope.
